request.subject: CITY:1

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: TEST clockwork wind-up tin soldiers; boxy chunky automaton bodies of riveted dark blue-grey gunmetal with a round glass porthole eye instead of a face, ivory-white enamel panels, small brass rivets and gear teeth and a big wind-up key on the back; towns of drum-shaped riveted iron workshops with domed roofs, a clock tower with a big white clock face, pipes and short chimney stacks.
layers.negative: wood, timber, thatch, straw, plaster, cottage, stone keep, copper, rust, orange, magic glow, gun, rifle, pistol

layers.text: Class: one settlement map piece, a compact cluster of chunky buildings that fills most of the image, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes. The walls and houses stand directly on the empty transparent background with no ground, soil, grass or platform under them; the bottom of the buildings is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, people, crowd

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the figure; no other red or red-brown anywhere, so leather, wood, shields, boots and bows use browns that are clearly not red.

Subject: a small level-1 clockwork town: one short round dark gunmetal clock tower with a big white clock face, a bright red enamel dome roof and a big red banner flag, and three chunky drum-shaped iron workshops with ivory-white walls and solid bright red enamel dome roofs pressed around its foot, one short chimney stack; no wall; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
